topics.title: Teenager Injured by Pipe Bomb
topics.summary: A 17-year-old supplied a pipe bomb to another teenager, resulting in critical injuries including loss of hand and genital damage. Police suspect the device was used for recreational explosions after the 16 year old victim lost his right hand and three fingers of his left hand, along with significant damage to his genitalia.

topics.title: Gangland Revelations and Psychic Predictions
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio broadcast, callers recount experiences with drug dealing, military service involving munitions and bizarre injuries like lost penises, and gang affiliations. A psychic offers unsettling predictions including death, infidelity, minor accidents, and the potential for fatal injury – all while discussing marital discord and offering unsolicited advice on relationships.

topics.title: Radio Ratings & Personal Mishaps

The conversation then veered into unrelated topics including rumors about Mark Chernoff, personal criticisms of other personalities, and bizarre predictions like someone being impregnated by Looney Skip Rooney.

topics.title: Advertising Budget and Listener Discussions

They engage in playful banter about station employees like Mark's overly enthusiastic behavior and explore Jackie’s departure following an unusual medical procedure involving brain surgery on epileptic patients.

topics.title: Radio Show, Joan Rivers and the KKK Hotline
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss television personality Joan Rivers’ attendance at a TV syndicator convention with her dog Spike, expressing disbelief about her attachment to him. They then engage in an unexpected phone call from Bruce Dickinson promoting a KKK hotline (1-800-Burning Cross), alongside discussions of station policy and the absurdity of bringing pets to professional events.

topics.title: Mark’s Birthday & Mafia Rumors

Callers discuss John Gotti and accusations against Italian-Americans, alongside bizarre claims regarding a NYC high school graduate warranty program and attempts to determine if callers are Irish.
